cover.desc: Full color, bright afternoon, deliberately the loudest cover so far. The Sakuragawa shotengai at 5pm in flat gold light — faded awnings, a crate of vegetables, the tofu shop's blue curtain. In the foreground, hard right, Gonda in mid-tiptoe behind a vending machine with both hands cupped round his eyes like binoculars, absolutely committed, wearing an expression of enormous strategic confidence. Middle distance: Itsuki walking away up the street with his hands in his jersey pockets, entirely oblivious, school bag hooked on one shoulder. Far background, small and slightly out of focus at the very top of the frame, half-hidden behind a telephone pole: the indigo noren of Kotobuki-yu, forty metres further on. The joke is in the foreground and the danger is in the background and they are in the same picture. Warm reds and yellows; the only cool colour in the frame is that noren.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: face-down on his desk, one arm hanging

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: leaning over him, finger extended, poking

panels.bg: classroom, 8:20am, morning light, students filing in
panels.action: A week and a half of nights at the bathhouse. He looks better than he has in four years, which is the problem.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: lifting his head, hair flattened on one side

panels.bg: desk, morning light
panels.action: He wakes up in a good mood. Again.

dialogue.text: You slept through the train. Both trains.
Mm.

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: straightening up slowly

panels.bg: classroom, blurred students
panels.action: Gonda has known this face for eleven years and it has never once done this.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: >_<, detective cap, magnifying glass, tiny body huge head
chars.pose: gesturing at a blackboard covered in string and arrows

chars.name: aya
chars.pose: seated in the front row taking notes

panels.bg: empty classroom at lunch, blackboard covered in red string, arrows, badly drawn portraits, chaos lines
panels.action: Comedy spike. Gonda has built a case. It is a bad case.

dialogue.text: Exhibit A. He has been PLEASANT. For nine days.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: grave, dot eyes, pointing at nothing
chars.pose: chibi, holding up two fingers

chars.name: aya
chars.pose: chibi, hands over mouth

panels.bg: blackboard, sparkle tone, chaos lines
panels.action: The evidence mounts.

dialogue.text: Exhibit B. He said no to the arcade.
He's never said no to the arcade!

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: back to normal proportions, suddenly serious
chars.pose: hand flat on the blackboard, looking at his own string diagram

panels.bg: empty classroom, blackboard, afternoon light, the chibi register dropped entirely
panels.action: Art drops out of chibi for one panel. He is not actually playing.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: casual in a way that is not casual
chars.pose: appearing at Nagi's desk, one hand on the back of the chair

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: seated, pen moving

panels.bg: classroom, window seat, afternoon light
panels.action: Aya, now deputised, opens her investigation.

dialogue.text: Shirakawa-san. Where were you Saturday night?

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: not looking up

panels.bg: desk, paper, flat screentone
panels.action: First lie. She does not embellish. She subtracts.

dialogue.text: I was elsewhere.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: frozen, eyes enormous, entire face working
chars.pose: standing very still as Nagi packs her bag and leaves the frame

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: bag on shoulder, walking out

panels.bg: classroom, students blurred, afternoon light
panels.action: It is the single most suspicious answer available to a human being.

dialogue.text: ...Elsewhere.
Nobody says elsewhere.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: brow very slightly drawn — for her, this is panic
chars.pose: stopped on an empty stairwell landing, hand on the rail

panels.bg: school stairwell, tall window, late gold light, nobody around
panels.action: She reviews her own performance and finds it wanting.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: speaking quietly to the stairwell

panels.bg: stairwell, window light, flat screentone
panels.action: She tries out a normal human answer, alone, at conversational volume.

dialogue.text: I was at a friend's house.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: standing perfectly still

chars.name: student_a
chars.pose: first-year going up the stairs sideways

panels.bg: stairwell, gold light
panels.action: A first-year has heard the entire thing. She never attempts it again.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: bright, arms wide, entirely without agenda
chars.pose: walking backwards in front of Itsuki

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: walking, bag on shoulder

panels.bg: school corridor, end of day, orange light
panels.action: Gonda makes an ordinary offer, the way he has for eleven years.

dialogue.text: Friday. Arcade. That terrible crepe place after.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: counting reasons off on his fingers

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: stopped walking

panels.bg: corridor, lockers, orange light
panels.action: Second lie. His failure mode is the exact opposite of hers. He keeps adding.

dialogue.text: Can't. Dentist.
And my aunt's visiting. From Chiba.
It's a whole situation.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: pleasant, and not fooled for one second
chars.pose: hands in pockets

panels.bg: corridor, blurred orange light
panels.action: Gonda is not stupid, and he has never once made Itsuki pay for a lie.

dialogue.text: ...Right. Next week, then.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: at the shoe lockers with four classmates

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: watching him from twenty feet away, not smiling
chars.pose: standing alone by the door, bag on shoulder

panels.bg: school entrance hall, shoe lockers, low evening sun through the doors
panels.action: The decision is not made out of suspicion.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: worried, plain, none of the clowning
chars.pose: eyes on his friend

panels.bg: entrance hall, blurred warm light
panels.action: He has watched this boy carry something for four years and never once been allowed to know what. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: walking up a residential street, hands in jersey pockets

panels.bg: suburban street after school, low sun, power lines, a dog behind a fence
panels.action: Itsuki goes the way he goes every day now.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: >_<, dark sunglasses, collar up, tiny body huge head
chars.pose: flattened against a lamppost far too narrow to hide him

panels.bg: same street, chaos lines, dramatic starburst screentone
panels.action: Comedy spike. The lamppost is nine centimetres wide.

dialogue.text: Subject is moving. Subject suspects nothing.

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: chibi, rolling behind a vending machine

panels.bg: street corner, vending machine, speed lines
panels.action: He commits a combat roll in a school uniform in public.

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: chibi, hiding inside a stack of plastic crates outside a greengrocer

panels.bg: the mouth of the Sakuragawa shotengai, awnings, chaos lines
panels.action: The tail reaches the shopping street.

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: peering over a bin lid

panels.bg: shotengai, faded awnings, sparkle tone
panels.action: He is enjoying himself enormously.

dialogue.text: Nowhere to run, Nomu. Nowhere to run.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: walking, one hand raised in greeting to a shopkeeper off-panel

panels.bg: shotengai, half-shuttered fronts, long shadows
panels.action: Itsuki greets somebody he now knows by name.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: chibi grin faltering, one eyebrow going up
chars.pose: peering, head tilted

panels.bg: bin lid, shotengai blur
panels.action: Since when does Nomu know anyone here?

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: mid-street, forty metres from the noren

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: twenty metres behind him beside a shuttered front

panels.bg: the full length of the Sakuragawa shotengai in evening light, and at the far end, unmistakable, the indigo noren of Kotobuki-yu with steam rising behind it. ART NOTE: chibi register ends here and does not return this chapter — the moment the noren is in frame the drawing goes fully realistic.
panels.action: Full page. The joke and the danger, finally in the same shot. Nobody is being funny any more.

panels.bg: a dark shuttered shopfront window, and in the reflection a crouching figure twenty metres back
panels.action: A shop window does what shop windows do.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopped dead, all the ease gone out of him
chars.pose: half-turned, hand still in his pocket

panels.bg: shotengai, evening light, noren visible small and terrible behind him
panels.action: Twenty-five metres. Silent.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: caught, frozen mid-crouch, hands still up like binoculars
chars.pose: squatting behind absolutely nothing

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: fully turned around now

panels.bg: open shotengai street, long shadows, nowhere to hide
panels.action: They look at each other across twenty metres of empty road.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: straightening up, embarrassed, dropping the act entirely
chars.pose: standing, brushing his knees off, not meeting his eyes

panels.bg: shotengai, evening light
panels.action: He does not say caught you. He does not say what are you hiding.

dialogue.text: You've been happy.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: plain, a bit awkward, entirely sincere
chars.pose: hands in pockets, shrugging one shoulder

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: standing in the road

panels.bg: shotengai, long shadows
panels.action: The real reason, said badly, which is how real reasons get said.

dialogue.text: Like, two weeks of it.
I wanted to know what did it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: nothing prepared, mouth opening on no sentence at all
chars.pose: standing very still

panels.bg: evening light, blurred street
panels.action: He has a lie for suspicion. He does not have a lie for that.

dialogue.text: ...Gon.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: stopping, taking in the whole situation in one pass
chars.pose: coming round the corner with a crate of towels braced on her hip

panels.bg: the tofu shop's blue curtain, shotengai, evening light
panels.action: She comes round the corner with Ban's crate and reads the entire scene in about a second and a half.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyes flicking to her once and back, everything else on his face unchanged
chars.pose: still facing Gonda

panels.bg: evening light, blurred street
panels.action: One glance. Half a second. Exactly the way he looks at her across a wet floor when he wants to know which bucket.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely nothing moving, eyes steady on him
chars.pose: crate on her hip, already walking again

panels.bg: shotengai, evening light, flat screentone
panels.action: She reads it. Nobody in the street sees a thing happen. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: setting the crate down on the kerb without stopping to be introduced

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: half-round

panels.bg: kerb outside the tofu shop, blue curtain, evening light
panels.action: Third lie. She states it as a fact, because that is the only way she knows how to say anything.

dialogue.text: He works at Kuroda Tofu.

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: pointing vaguely at both

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: catching up in real time and landing it
chars.pose: hands back in his pockets, shrugging

panels.bg: shotengai, tofu shop front
panels.action: He picks it up on the first pass. They have done this before, in a different room, about buckets.

dialogue.text: ...What?
Evenings.

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: picking the crate back up, leaving the frame

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: hand on chest

panels.bg: shotengai, evening light
panels.action: She adds the one detail that makes it unanswerable — a small insult, delivered on her way past.

dialogue.text: He carries crates. Badly.

chars.name: gonda
chars.pose: eyebrows up

panels.bg: the tofu shop's blue curtain, a hand and one shoulder just visible inside, nothing more
panels.action: From inside the shop, without appearing, Kuroda Ban corroborates.

dialogue.text: Mm.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: relief flooding him, whole body loosening, laughing
chars.pose: shoving Itsuki's shoulder with both hands

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: taking it

panels.bg: shotengai, evening light, warm awnings
panels.action: It works. It works instantly and completely.

dialogue.text: Why didn't you just SAY that, idiot?
I'd have come and heckled you.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: grinning, walking away backwards, both arms up
chars.pose: retreating down the street

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: standing in the road

panels.bg: shotengai, long evening shadows
panels.action: He goes home happy. He got an answer, and it came from his best friend, so it is true.

dialogue.text: Wear the apron! I want to see the apron!

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hand still half-raised, smile still on, catchlights shrunk to pinpricks
chars.pose: watching him go

panels.bg: empty shotengai, low sun, the shape of Gonda small and receding
panels.action: It worked because Gonda believes him. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: standing in the middle of the road

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unreadable, stopped a few paces off
chars.pose: crate on her hip again, waiting

panels.bg: shotengai, evening, the noren visible up the street
panels.action: She does not ask if he is all right. She would not know what to do with the answer.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, holding the crate out at arm's length
chars.pose: offering him the heavy end

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: looking at the crate, then at her
chars.pose: hands coming out of his pockets

panels.bg: shotengai, warm evening light
panels.action: She hands him something to carry. It is the only comfort she has ever known how to offer.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: carrying the crate, walking up the street beside her

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: hands free now, walking

panels.bg: the shotengai from behind them, evening light, the indigo noren forty metres ahead
panels.action: They walk toward it together and neither of them discusses whether to.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: arm up, unhooking the noren from outside

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance at 11:33pm, sign off, one warm lamp, cold clear night
panels.action: Closing. He takes the noren down without being asked, the way he took the bucket.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: handing over a bad fold, unbothered
chars.pose: holding out a lumpy bundle of indigo cloth

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: taking it, already refolding, saying nothing
chars.pose: shaking it out and folding it in three practised movements

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, counter
panels.action: He folds it wrong. She refolds it without comment. He watches exactly how, so that next time he won't.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.pose: phone lit in one hand

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, dark room behind
panels.action: His phone, face-up on the counter.

dialogue.text: Sota's asking about the bathhouse. Every single day.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: about to say something, deciding not to
chars.pose: looking across the room at her, phone lowering

chars.name: nagi
chars.pose: working at the far side of the changing room

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, wide floor between them
panels.action: He doesn't say it. Not tonight.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, doing it while he can't see
chars.pose: reaching up to a small hook on the wall above the shelf

panels.bg: corner of the bath hall, shelf, the red bucket on the floor below with three brushes standing in it
panels.action: While he is putting his shoes on, she hangs something up.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopped, one shoe half on, looking across the room
chars.pose: crouched at the genkan, head turned

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — walking away, back turned
chars.pose: already going, cloth over her shoulder

panels.bg: long view from the genkan across the changing room into the bath hall, one lamp, steam
panels.action: He catches it. She does not turn round to be caught doing it.

panels.bg: a single blue-handled scrubbing brush hanging alone on its own hook on the tiled wall, dry, bristles clean, warm lamplight on it. Below and to the side, out of focus, the red bucket with the other three standing in it.
panels.action: One brush that lives apart from the others, because it belongs to somebody. Final panel. Silent.
